notes.title: “Fragment：A Story in Growing” Full Voice Version Now Available!
notes.notes:
[b]What's New:[/b]
[b][Fully Voiced Chinese Dialogue][/b]
Even after the game's launch, our team never stopped creating. Through the extraordinary efforts of our voice acting team, we're proud to deliver a fully voiced experience. A heartfelt thank you to every player who supported us – simply update your game now to enjoy the captivating performances. We believe this upgrade will immerse you deeper into Wei Ran's unfolding story.

The Bee Kingdom has reclaimed its lost voices. Within the pages of this tale, Wei Ran awaits your company – to revisit half-forgotten faces, relive bittersweet moments, and grow alongside her once more.

[b][Reduced Star Requirements for New Chapters][/b]
We've lowered the Star threshold needed to unlock main story chapters, letting you progress through the narrative faster than ever.

[b][Text Error Fixes][/b]

Since [i]Fragment：A Story in Growing[/i] launched, your invaluable feedback has shaped our journey. As a fledgling team, we’re profoundly grateful for your trust in our growing pains.

notes.title: Fragment: A Story in Growing is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44633732/ed03cfae38384da355e4d70b41ff1c001c848162.png[/img]

Dear grown-up children，

We are excited to announce that Fragment: A Story in Growing is now available for $12.99 with a 15% discount during the first two weeks. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44633732/daa947abf57fa1a1785ffad5d35f6f34e02bba1e.gif[/img]

[b]This could be your life. [/b]You will take control of a young father hustling in the workplace, who faces the challenges of his unequal workplace environment, with meagre salaries and the escalating expenses of a growing daughter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44633732/a229821fbfb26de15dbba13483332c4ac5308973.png[/img]

In this text-based narrative-driven game, you make choices by grouping different words. Besides the main story,  you also need to keep a balance. You need to deal with random events come with different themes (work, socializing, parenting and private time) and it affect your health, money and mood. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44633732/fe7a48e5304f6aea71cf909ca72d4a5e94cfbc53.png[/img]

As the story progresses, you can also check your past in a photo album, basking in the afterglow of growing up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44633732/b298b475da7f5f353079eb44f5525e9940d44831.png[/img]

notes.title: Free Trial Demo | Raising Daughter in the Millennium
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44633732/5f346bcb719c3311591a178a29becab4083472fd.jpg[/img]
Hello, new parents! Thank you for your patience. After 3 months of development and optimization, we are pleased to announce: 

Our existential life simulation game "Fragment: A Story In Growing " [b]will be officially launched on June 25![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2821690/

The production team will gradually optimize and update features based on the feedback from the test players in the near future.

Also we will debut at Steam's Eastern GameFest on April 26, 2024, with a brand-new promotional video and playable Demo!

Looking forward to your feedback！


[h2]What's new in the DEMO?[/h2]
Your middle school daughter seems to have her own secrets, causing you endless worries. Meanwhile, a colleague's words unexpectedly trigger memories of your deceased wife... How will you navigate this family crisis? 

The time machine to your daughter's 15th birthday is about to start. 3, 2, 1... Let's go!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44633732/daa947abf57fa1a1785ffad5d35f6f34e02bba1e.gif[/img]

[h1]v1.3 Version Update[/h1]
[h2]Function Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added local save function.
[*] Added English localization support.
[*] Added windowed mode and resolution adjustment in settings.
[*] Added volume adjustment in settings.
[*] Revised game structure and added a plot node selection interface.
[*] Added level system and gameplay for level tasks.
[*] Added illustration function.
[/list]
[h2]Content Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Revised beginner tutorial for better understanding!
[*] Optimized plot text and added more branching details.
[*] Overall UI updates.
[*] Added some game CGs and numerous illustrations.
[*] Added some background music and sound effects.
[/list]
